focus: Letters in print and molten 70s lettering across landing and digital product styling

directions.name: Print house
directions.note: Ivory and navy, oversized printed lettering, quiet product surfaces and confident animal-pattern panels.
directions.brief: Warm ivory and midnight navy with dusty rose accents. Large crisp bubble 70s finfolk wordmark in the HERO with octopus textile visibly clipped inside its letters, exactly the energy of reference 1 but more voluptuous letter silhouettes. The desktop landing is editorial and spacious: a slim navy top navigation, oversized printed hero logo across upper third, short strong heading 'Find your folk. Find your depth.', pill CTA 'Explore Finfolk', right-side app preview showing real beach directory cards, lower section of three quiet feature panels for Places, Logbook, Buddies. One large cropped octopus-print area sets the page tone without overwhelming body text. Product screens have clean solid ivory cards, high-contrast navy text, generous space, pill tabs, printed Australian state silhouette thumbnails with a simple location dot. This is luxurious and quirky, not boho rustic.
directions.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: high-fidelity 1536x1024 landscape design comparison board showing a NEW Finfolk landing page and its matching DIGITAL PRODUCT styling.
Brand context: strictly freedivers and freediving training. The selected identity is "Letters in print" plus puffy, fluid, lava-lamp 70s lettering. Image 1 = selected printed wordmark; image 2 = molten typography; image 3 = muted animal print; image 4 = hyper animal print. Create a coherent original design, not a collage of references.
Board composition: LEFT TWO-THIRDS is one large desktop web landing page shown flat and front-on, including navigation, hero, real-looking app preview and first content section. RIGHT THIRD is two narrow mobile interface screens side by side: one mobile LANDING page and one mobile APP screen. At the bottom of the overall board show a compact product component strip with a beach card, logbook session card and animal/theme selector. Precise aligned layout, sensible spacing, 44px touch controls at realistic scale. No physical merchandise, no actual device photography, no perspective skew. No headings outside the UI.
Finfolk digital product has: beach directory grouped by Australian state; state-map thumbnails with pattern clipped INSIDE silhouette and a location dot; logbook; profile and buddies; global settings including independent animal choice and muted/hyper themes. Use these familiar feature names and no invented services, booking, subscriptions, coaching sales, spearfishing or live condition guarantees.
UI text: use only short legible labels. Header 'Places', 'Logbook', 'Your folk', 'Settings'; main CTA 'Explore Finfolk'; main line 'Find your folk. Find your depth.'; example place cards 'Portsea' / 'VIC' and 'Clovelly' / 'NSW'; product label 'Your logbook'; settings 'Choose your animal', 'Octopus', 'Lionfish', 'Quiet'. No fake statistics, testimonial text or paragraphs of gibberish.
Design constraints: prominent animal motifs, but quiet solid readable content surfaces. No printed card borders/frames. Big printed wordmark must be clearly readable 'finfolk' (seven letters f i n f o l k), never an ff favicon. The small navigation/app icon is ONE lowercase f. Main logo can be lavish; small UI labels stay simple clean sans-serif.

One large cropped octopus-print area sets the page tone without overwhelming body text. Product screens have clean solid ivory cards, high-contrast navy text, generous space, pill tabs, printed Australian state silhouette thumbnails with a simple location dot. This is luxurious and quirky, not boho rustic.

directions.name: Acid social
directions.note: Cobalt, hot pink and acid yellow with printed bubble lettering and calm, solid areas for reading and controls.
directions.brief: Bold acid yellow, cobalt and hot pink palette, using reference 4's hyper lionfish motif. The desktop landing feels like an exuberant high-fashion swimming club: giant puffy molten 70s finfolk logotype filled with recognizable lionfish textile fragments, cobalt navigation on acid yellow, bold 'Find your folk. Find your depth.' and hot pink pill CTA 'Explore Finfolk'. A full-bleed cropped animal-print background field sits behind an off-centre white app preview. The PRODUCT screens stay highly readable on solid pale-ivory cards with cobalt labels and big pill controls; hyper motif only in section backgrounds and clipped state silhouettes. Mobile landing stacks giant logo, one short headline, large button, then app preview. No garish patterned card frames. Contemporary and controlled despite vivid colour.

directions.name: Midnight current
directions.note: Deep navy, ivory and rose, with a printed wordmark, luminous motif fields and soft rounded controls.
directions.brief: Deep midnight navy background, warm ivory type, soft dusty rose and subtle cobalt accents. Sophisticated nocturnal couture freediving club. Desktop landing has dramatic large molten 70s finfolk lettering across hero, ivory outer silhouette with a limited ivory/rose octopus print INSIDE letterforms so it reads on navy. Heading 'Find your folk. Find your depth.' in an elegant chunky rounded display style, ivory CTA 'Explore Finfolk'. Use a large octopus textile crop in one flowing organic panel, not a photograph. Product styling: deep navy page surrounds, solid warm ivory content panels, rounded pill tabs, neat navy body type, printed Australian state thumbnails with a bright rose dot, restrained moonlit mood. Mobile logbook and settings must look usable, uncluttered and related to landing. No gradients, neon glow or glassmorphism.
